role: Stanford 201427, Svensson Lab LSRP1, GLP-1 in cancer
data_role: External reference experiment supporting in-vivo cancer-study comparison. Not target-lab data.
license: CC BY 4.0. Attribution retained. Derived numbers are computed independently from the source workbook.
experimental_unit: The Fig. 3 caption reports every n as an individual mouse. Workbook source labels are panel-local and do not establish cross-panel matching or identify the two pooled experiment batches.

used_ranges.meaning: Day-16 final tumor volume in mm3, six treatment groups; blanks omitted, not imputed
Gzmb+ Perforin+ percentage among TRP2 H-2Kb+ cells, six groups; blanks omitted, not imputed

new_contribution: Within-mouse body-mass change and consistent endpoint-specific group summaries expose why weight response, tumor volume, and T-cell function require distinct controls. Unadjusted group contrasts and sample-size transparency support experiment planning, not new efficacy claims.
source_not_published: Original workbook is downloaded at reproduction time into a temporary directory and checksum-checked. The public site contains only minimal selected derived data and exact source-cell locations.
excluded: No clinical efficacy or safety claims
No inferential P values or confidence intervals
No simulated observations or imputed missing source values
